backseat_ride.name: Sunday Drive
backseat_ride.role_title: a joyful passenger leaning out of a car window
backseat_ride.pose_sentence: The {pronoun} is leaning boldly out of the passenger-side car window, front paws draped over the door panel, head fully outside the car and facing forward into the wind. The body is angled outward and downward, chest resting on the window frame — the lower body and hind legs remain inside the car, completely out of frame. The camera angle is low and slightly from the side, looking up at the subject against the open road.
backseat_ride.props_sentence: A pair of dark wayfarer sunglasses is worn correctly over the eyes — lenses covering both eyes, nose bridge resting on the snout, temples hooked behind the ears. The glasses sit low on the face at eye level, not pushed up on the forehead or top of the head. The car door and window frame are visible beneath the front paws.
backseat_ride.environment: viewed from just outside and slightly below the car window — the open door panel and chrome trim in the foreground, and stretching behind the subject a long straight highway road disappearing into the horizon, flanked by trees and open landscape with a wide golden sky
backseat_ride.lighting: Warm sunset backlight from low on the horizon directly ahead, casting a golden rim glow around the subject's head and shoulders, with soft warm haze over the road behind.

royal_cushion.name: Royal Portrait
royal_cushion.role_title: a regal aristocrat in a classical oil portrait
royal_cushion.pose_sentence: The {pronoun} is lying reclined on a large ornate cushion, body fully visible in a three-quarter side profile — the full length of the body is visible from head to hindquarters, with front paws stretched forward on the cushion. The head is turned toward the camera, gaze calm and direct. The camera is positioned slightly elevated and to one side, looking down at a gentle angle — the composition shows the full body lying on the cushion as the dominant shape of the image.
royal_cushion.props_sentence: A rich crimson silk royal robe is draped directly over the back and shoulders of the figure — it sits on the body, not beside it — falling in heavy folds down the side of the cushion. White ermine trim and delicate gold lace edging line the robe. The cushion beneath is large and ornate, upholstered in teal damask brocade with gold tassel trim at the corners.
royal_cushion.environment: a simple, timeless dark neutral background — smooth and slightly graduated from dark grey to warm brown, with no architectural detail, in the style of a classical European oil portrait
royal_cushion.lighting: Soft, even old-master portrait lighting from slightly above and to the front — warm and diffused, with gentle highlights on the face and fabric folds and soft shadow falloff into the background. No harsh light sources.

rainy_window.name: Rainy Day
rainy_window.role_title: a pensive figure on a rain-streaked windowsill
rainy_window.pose_sentence: The {pronoun} is seated on a wide indoor windowsill, body upright and centered, facing directly toward the camera. Front paws rest neatly on the sill in front. The lower body is hidden below the sill ledge — only the head, chest, and front paws are visible.
rainy_window.environment: a cozy indoor room — the wide windowsill frames the figure, and behind the glass rain runs in streaks and rivulets down the pane, the world outside reduced to soft blurred grey-green tones of wet trees and rooftops. The interior behind is warm and dim.
rainy_window.lighting: Flat, cool diffused light from the overcast sky outside the window, softly illuminating the face from the front with no harsh shadows. Warm interior ambient light adds a faint golden glow from behind and to the sides.

autumn_bench.name: Autumn Afternoon
autumn_bench.role_title: a contemplative figure on an autumn park bench
autumn_bench.pose_sentence: The {pronoun} is seated upright on a wooden park bench, body centered and relaxed, facing directly toward the camera. Front paws rest side by side on the bench seat. The lower body is hidden by the bench — only the head, shoulders, and chest are visible above the back of the bench.
autumn_bench.props_sentence: Fallen autumn leaves are scattered across the bench and the ground below.
autumn_bench.environment: a quiet park in autumn — the bench sits on a leaf-strewn path with tall trees on either side, their canopies golden and amber, leaves drifting slowly through the air, the background softly blurred into warm orange and yellow tones
autumn_bench.lighting: Soft warm afternoon light filtering through the autumn canopy, casting gentle dappled patches of gold across the bench and the ground, with an overall warm amber tone throughout the scene.
